sources.title: Halcyon docs & whitepaper v2.3
sources.excerpt: Isolated-market lending on Ethereum and Arbitrum. Mainnet since 2024-03. Risk curators set per-market parameters; liquidations via Dutch auction. Chainlink primary oracle with Uniswap v3 TWAP fallback and 5% deviation breaker. Fee switch: 35% of interest spread to stakers (live since 2025-09).

sources.title: HLCN tokenomics & vesting schedule
sources.excerpt: 1B fixed supply. Team 18% (12m cliff, 48m linear), investors 20% (12m cliff, 24m linear), treasury 27%, community incentives 25%, liquidity 10%. Net emissions ~4%/yr declining. All allocations in Sablier-style vesting contracts (addresses listed).

sources.title: Audit report — Firm A, v2 core (2025-11)
sources.excerpt: 0 critical, 2 high, 5 medium. Both highs (liquidation rounding; curator fee bypass) fixed and verified in v2.3.0.

sources.title: Audit report — Firm B, periphery & oracle adapter (2026-02)
sources.excerpt: 0 critical, 0 high, 3 medium (2 fixed, 1 acknowledged: TWAP window configurable by curator).

sources.title: Audit report — Firm C, v2.3 diff + formal verification of solvency invariants (2026-06)
Reviewer call with CEO and CTO, 2026-10-15 (notes)
sources.excerpt: Team of 23 FTE (11 eng, 2 security). CEO previously ran risk at a top-10 lending protocol; CTO ex-core contributor to a major L2 client. Key person: CTO holds design authority on liquidation engine; second senior engineer shadowing. Committed to sharing MM agreements under NDA — not yet received. Largest borrower is a market-making firm (~11% of borrows).

sources.title: KYC verification record: 4 founders + legal entity
Halcyon treasury report Q3 2026
sources.excerpt: Treasury $64M: 46% stablecoins/ETH, 54% HLCN. Monthly opex $1.15M. Incentives spend Q3 $2.9M vs protocol revenue $3.6M. Treasury addresses published; report reconciles to on-chain balances.

sources.title: News, court-record and regulator database search: Halcyon, founders, entity
sources.excerpt: No enforcement actions or litigation found. One 2025 forum allegation of insider front-running of a market listing, investigated by an independent delegate; on-chain review found no supporting evidence.

sources.title: Bug bounty programme listing
sources.excerpt: Max payout $500,000 for critical smart-contract bugs. 3 medium reports paid in 2026.

sources.title: Social analytics: X, Discord, Telegram, 90 days
sources.excerpt: X 96k followers, engagement rate 1.1% (peer median 0.8%). Bot-likelihood of top repliers 7%. Discord 21k, ~600 weekly active posters. Two disclosed paid campaigns in 90d.

sources.title: Token legal opinion (US + EU + SG), dated 2026-04
sources.excerpt: Opinion from a recognised international law firm. Concludes HLCN is unlikely to be a security in SG and EU (MiCA other crypto-asset), with moderate US risk noted given fee-share to stakers. Foundation in Cayman, development company in Switzerland. Front end geoblocks US, OFAC jurisdictions.

sources.title: Cap table & fundraising history
sources.excerpt: Seed 2023 at $0.03/token led by an established crypto fund; Series A 2024 at $0.10/token co-led by two established funds that also backed the team through the 2025 drawdown. Current price $0.42.
